project_type: Angular 19 bookstore SPA with standalone components
test_framework: Karma + Jasmine. Tests use TestBed.configureTestingModule with standalone component imports. Tests live next to their source files as *.spec.ts
verification_instructions: 1. Run npx ng build to verify production build succeeds. 2. Run test command above to verify all tests pass.
setup_instructions: npm install in project root. Chrome dependencies already installed via dnf (nss nspr atk cups-libs libdrm mesa-libgbm libXcomposite libXdamage libXrandr libxkbcommon pango alsa-lib at-spi2-atk). Puppeteer Chrome at /root/.cache/puppeteer/chrome/linux-146.0.7680.31/chrome-linux64/chrome.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network. Node v22. Chrome available at /root/.cache/puppeteer/chrome/linux-146.0.7680.31/chrome-linux64/chrome. Must set CHROME_BIN env var when running tests.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md. Follow existing patterns: standalone components with inline templates and inline styles, services with BehaviorSubject/Observable pattern, CSS custom properties for theming.
key_patterns: All components are standalone (standalone: true). Templates and styles are inline in @Component decorator. Components use CommonModule, RouterLink, AsyncPipe as needed. Services are providedIn: 'root'. Observable data flows via async pipe in templates. Angular 19 @if/@for control flow syntax (not *ngIf/*ngFor). App uses @angular/forms (already in package.json dependencies). Tests use real services (not mocked) injected via TestBed. Routes in app.routes.ts with lazy-free imports. Cart has clearCart() method already implemented.
directory_structure: src/app/components/ - feature components (book-detail, book-list, cart, header). src/app/services/ - book.service.ts and cart.service.ts. src/app/models/ - book.model.ts and cart-item.model.ts. Each component is a single .ts file with inline template and styles, plus a .spec.ts test file.
